srList.sentence: The following inclusion and exclusion criteria was referred to while recruiting men for the study: Inclusion Criteria The men belonging to age range of 18 - 39 years who were in a heterosexual relationship at least for the last 6 months without history of medical, psychiatric, and hormonal disease and dysfunction, drug use including recreational drugs, obese and those not using hypertension and heart medications were included in the sample.

srList.sentence: Participants One hundred thirty-seven men with NOED were screened eligible and recruited to participate in the study out of total of 164 men referred to the principal investigator from sexual health clinics in South Punjab, Pakistan.
